怎样从矩阵读出旋转阶数？: How do you read the rotation order from the matrix?
求正旋转矩阵三项对角元素之和。行列式为负时，先对原矩阵取负。: Add the three diagonal entries of the proper rotation matrix. If the determinant is negative, negate the original matrix first.
